descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the Dream Executioner is a Scythe and a lantern. In its Transformed state, the weapon is a single massive Maul.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

**Untransformed.** The Scythe gains the Harvest property.

**Harvest.** Whenever a creature of CR 1 or higher (or level 1 or higher) dies within 15 feet of you, the lantern harvests the creature's soul. The soul becomes trapped in the lantern, and the creature can't be resurrected until the soul is freed. As a Magic action, you can free a soul trapped in the lantern. The lantern can hold a maximum of one soul.

**Transformed.** The Maul gains the Soul Explosion property.

**Soul Explosion.** When you hit a creature with this weapon while a soul is held in the lantern, you can sacrifice the soul, permanently destroying it, to create a massive explosion of ghostflame. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from you must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 Radiant damage and 2d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Undead automatically fail the saving throw.

name: Galvanized Claw
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

While attuned to this weapon, you have Resistance|XPHB to Lightning and Thunder damage.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the claw is a sinewy leather gauntlet, made from the muscle and hide of a galvanized prowler. In its Transformed state, the claw surges with electrical energy, merging with its wearer's forearm and turning into a monstrous claw.

**Untransformed.** The bestial hide invigorates you, giving you the lightning fast reflexes of the galvanized prowler slaughtered to make this gauntlet; you have Advantage|XPHB on Initiative|XPHB rolls. In addition, this gauntlet feeds off of your power. If you have Temporary Hit Points|XPHB when you hit with a melee attack, you deal an extra 1d6 Lightning damage.

The gauntlet has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you take Lighting or Thunder damage, you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 charge to instead take no damage and gain a number of Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to the damage you would have taken.

**Transformed.** The gauntlet merges with your form, turning your hand into an aberrant claw that you can't be disarmed of. This claw changes the damage of your Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes to 1d8, the damage type to Slashing, and you can use your Dexterity or Strength modifier for the attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. Further, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

When you take the Attack action with this claw, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action|XPHB. In addition, if you have Temporary Hit Points|XPHB, when you hit with a melee attack using this claw, you deal an extra 1d8 Lightning damage.

The claw is too unwieldy to use for delicate handling, such as activating intricate mechanisms (like the trigger of a firearm) or picking locks with Thieves' Tools.

name: Meat Hookshot
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, uncommon*

**Properties:** TK

---

When the Manikin of the Sloered Abattoir gained sentience, the Scions sent enforcers to quell this threat to Luyarnha's delicate existence. From the abattoir's meat hooks and the blunderbusses of the slain enforcers, The Slaughtered—as the manikins named themselves—crafted these versatile weapons. Nicknamed "the meat hook", the hookshot is a trick weapon used by hunters to help close the gap to their prey in a devastating whirl of blades and gunpowder.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the hookshot is two one-handed weapons connected by a short length of chain: a Sickle and a Blunderbuss. In its Transformed state, the weapon is a single two-handed weapon: a Blunderbuss with a bladed attachment that can act as a Battleaxe.

**Untransformed.** While Untransformed, the Sickle has the F|XPHB|Finesse property, and the Blunderbuss doesn't have the 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed property. Using this pair of weapons together requires the Sickle to be held in one hand and the Blunderbuss in the other. When you take the Attack action with the Sickle, you can make an attack with the Blunderbuss as a Bonus Action|XPHB, ignoring the SGEHPP:Bar|SGEHPP|Barrel property.

**Transformed.** When you take the Attack action, you can attack with either the Blunderbuss or the bladed attachment (which uses the stats of a Battleaxe wielded with two hands). In addition, this item gains the Hookshot property.

**Hookshot.** As a Utilize action, you can launch the sickle from the Blunderbuss, to which it remains attached by a length of sturdy chain. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to 1d4 plus your Dexterity modifier. If the creature is your size or smaller, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled in a straight line to the nearest unoccupied space to you. If the creature is larger than you, you are pulled in a straight line to the nearest unoccupied space to it. At the end of your turn, the hook detaches from the creature and reattaches itself to the Blunderbuss.

name: Orphan's Cradle
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In both states, the weapon is a Morningstar with the R|XPHB|Reach property.

**Untransformed.** The flowers growing in the cradle exude a sickly sweet scent that calms the mind of men and chases away nightmares. Humanoids within 10 feet of the cradle have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions. In addition, the cradle has the Cleansing Miasma and Vile Miasma properties.

**Cleansing Miasma.** As a Magic action, you can cleanse one Humanoid you can see within 10 feet of you. It gains 1d12 Temporary Hit Points|XPHB and can end one of the following conditions: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned. Once a creature has benefited from this property, it can't benefit from it again for 1 hour.

**Vile Miasma.** When you hit a Beast or an Undead with this weapon, the target must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute, even if the target is Immunity|XPHB|immune to the Poisoned condition. A Poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is Immunity|XPHB|immune to Vile Miasma for the next 24 hours.

**Transformed.** When Transformed, the cradle's plants ignite, and it deals an extra 2d6 Fire damage on a hit. In addition, the weapon gains the Fanned Flames and Withering Flames properties.

**Fanned Flames.** As an action, you can rotate the cradle wildly around you, fanning the flames. Each creature in a 20-foot Cone must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage and 3d6 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Beasts and Undead have Disadvantage|XPHB on this saving throw. After this property is used, Orphan's Cradle reverts to its Untransformed state and can't be Transformed again for 1d4 rounds.

**Withering Flames.** When you hit a Beast or an Undead with this weapon, you can force the target to make a 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target has Vulnerability|XPHB to your choice of one of the following damage types until the start of its next turn: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Radiant. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is Immunity|XPHB|immune to Withering Flames for the next 24 hours.

name: Ravenous Gazer
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

Acquiring forbidden knowledge always comes at a cost. Any creature that attunes to this glaive is considered proficient with it. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the gazer is a Glaive. In its Transformed state, the gazer is a Glaive that can be used as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB.

To transform this weapon, you must feed it your blood: each time you shift this weapon into its Transformed state, or start your turn with the weapon in its Transformed state, you take 1d4 Necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way. This damage can't break your Concentration|XPHB.

**Transformed.** While the weapon is in its Transformed state, it grants you a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls, increases your spell save DC by 1, and gives you Truesight with a range of 30 feet.

name: Revelations
reqAttune: by a creature with a Strength of 15 or higher
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, very rare (by a creature with a Strength of 15 or higher)*

**Properties:** TK

---

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned to it, your sight improves as your vision starts echoing with that of the blade. While holding Revelations, you gain the following benefits:

- You can't be Surprised|XPHB.
- Other creatures don't gain Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.
- You are Immunity|XPHB|immune to the Blinded condition, as the sword absorbs the effect and closes two of its eyes instead, before regrowing them.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the weapon is a Cleaver studded with eyeballs. In its Transformed state, the weapon is a Whip composed of metal shards held together by a sinew of blood and flesh.

**Untransformed.** When you hit a creature with this Cleaver, you curse them for the next hour. For the duration, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with the weapon against the target, attack rolls you make with the weapon against the cursed target score a Critical Hit|XPHB on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20, and you have Advantage|XPHB on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find the target. The curse ends early if you transform the weapon or if you have the Unconscious condition.

**Transformed.** This Whip deals 1d6 Slashing damage on a hit, has the V|XPHB|Versatile (1d8) property, but does not have the F|XPHB|Finesse property. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with this weapon, you can attempt to crush them under the weight of the Whip. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 plus your Strength modifier and your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus) or take 1d6 Slashing damage and have the Prone condition.

**Curse: Devour Sight.** While attuned to this weapon, your sight deteriorates rapidly. For each five days that pass, you gain a permanent -1 penalty to all Wisdom (Perception) checks made using your sight. When this penalty reaches -5, your eyes rot and melt out. You have the Blinded condition, as two new eyes appear on the blade.

The sword's curse is insidious: while you remain attuned to the weapon, you do not suffer the penalty to your Perception checks, and you do not realize that your sight is worsening. The blade's influence makes you perceive the world in a clearer light.

name: Sacrificial Brand
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, varies*

---

To apply an Eldritch Carving, one must follow a gruesome process. Unlike most art, where the artist determines the quality of the art, with Eldritch Carvings, the canvas—the person getting carved— determines the quality of the work. The canvas must envision the rune in their mind as best they can, causing their body to distort under the eldritch pressure. The carver can then simply apply the necessary tool against the skin and let the eldritch powers move the brush, needle, or knife, depending on whether the Eldritch Carving is Drawn, Tattooed, or Scarified, respectively. This procedure takes 1 hour and can be done as part of a Short Rest|XPHB.

After the Eldritch Carving is complete, a creature is attuned to it (if required) and gains its effects. To remove an Eldritch Carving, the flesh where the Eldritch Carving is located needs to be thoroughly burnt. Burning a carving also removes Attunement|XPHB to it. Scarified Eldritch Carvings can't be removed.

The carving, notorious among hunters and commonly dubbed the "Brand of Death" is a harbinger of an early demise for those burdened with its curse. Nevertheless, Steinhardt and Martyr Tulio—valiant souls undaunted by fear—carved the eldritch sigil into their own skin willingly. By bearing the ominous symbol, they sought to lure the beasts closer to them during the Hunt, granting their brothers-in-arms moments of respite amidst the chaos.

**Drawn (Common).** During the three days of the Blood Moon, all Evil-aligned creatures within Luyarnha gain Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks to locate creatures with this Eldritch Carving.

**Tattooed (Uncommon).** During the three days of the Blood Moon, all Evil-aligned creatures within Luyarnha gain Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks to locate creatures with this Eldritch Carving. If they are within 120 feet of a creature bearing the Eldritch Carving, they know their exact location and receive a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against them.

**Scarified (Rare).** During the three days of the Blood Moon, all Evil-aligned creatures within Luyarnha gain Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks to locate creatures with this Eldritch Carving. If they are within 120 feet of a creature bearing the Eldritch Carving, they know their exact location and receive a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against them, and they have a -3 penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls against other creatures not bearing the brand.

In addition, creatures bearing this carving begin to painfully bleed from it when Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile monsters within 300 feet of them are aware of their position. They can't be Surprised|XPHB for the duration of the Blood Moon.

name: Shard of Moonlight
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, artifact (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

While attuned to this weapon, you gain the following benefits:

- You are proficient with Greatswords and Longswords.
- You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, and the blade deals an extra 1d6 Radiant damage on a hit.
- You have Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom saving throws, except those made to resist Madness.
- You can use this weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB.

**Sentience.** The Shard of Moonlight is a sentient weapon, with the same personality as the Great One whose flesh it was carved from. The weapon sporadically communicates telepathically with its wielder through images and sounds, though it doesn't speak.

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, the shard is a metallic Longsword that absorbs light. In its Transformed state, the weapon is a Greatsword that pulses with lunar energy. In both states, this weapon has the L|XPHB|Light property.

**Untransformed.** The blade seems to guide your strikes. Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with this weapon, you can immediately make a second attack (no action required). It has the Void Absorption property.

**Void Absorption.** The void that fills the blade is capable of absorbing magic. While holding the shard, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to absorb a spell that is targeting you, including spells with an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy—not the spell itself—is stored in the shard in the form of charges. The number of charges gained is equivalent to the level of the spell when it was cast (1 charge for cantrips). The shard can absorb and store up to 10 charges. If the shard doesn't have enough empty charges for a spell, it fails to absorb it. The shard regains all charges each time the moon changes.

**Transformed.** To transform the blade, you must take a Bonus Action|XPHB while under direct moonlight. The transformation lasts for 1 minute, or until you end it early as a Bonus Action|XPHB. While the blade is Transformed, the extra Radiant damage it deals on a hit increases from 1d6 to 2d6, and you can expend the charges stored within the shard. When the shard loses all charges, the transformation ends.

Each time you make an attack in the Transformed state, you can expend charges to create special effects:

**Revealing Glow.** As part of making an attack, you can expend 1 charge to empower the blade. On a hit, it deals an extra 1d12 Radiant damage, and until the start of your next turn, the target sheds Dim Light|XPHB in a 10-foot radius. While affected by the light, the target can't have the Invisible condition, and attack rolls against it have Advantage|XPHB.

**Transient Moonlight.** As part of making an attack, you can expend 2 charges to release a wave of moonlight where the blade slashes, creating a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line of moonlight originating from you. Each creature in the area must make a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Lunar Explosion.** Instead of making an attack, you can expend 3 charges to raise the blade upward and release a burst of moonlight energy. Each creature in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from you must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 3d12 Radiant damage and has the Prone condition. If a creature falls Prone within 5 feet of you, you can immediately take a Reaction|XPHB to make a melee weapon attack against them with the shard. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

name: Torture Tools
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 10 lb | **Value:** 20 gp

---

This satchel contains various small implements that can bludgeon, cut, and pierce in ways designed to maximize pain. Meant to extract the truth, many use these tools with far more nefarious intentions.

Proficiency with these tools grants the following benefits:

**Exhaustion.** Using these tools for 1 hour on a Restrained creature causes it to gain 1 Exhaustion level, after which you must make a Dexterity (Torture Tools) check. The DC is equal to 20 minus the creature's Constitution modifier. On a failure, the creature takes 10 points of your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

**Intimidation.** When you make a Charisma (Intimidation) check against a creature you have previously used these tools on, you gain a bonus to the roll equal to twice your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

name: Unstable Crumbler
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Properties:** TK

---

While holding this weapon, your attacks and spells deal double damage to structures, and Fire damage you take is reduced by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

**Trick Weapon.** As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch between the Transformed and Untransformed states of this weapon. In its Untransformed state, this weapon is a roaring Cannon with smoke coming out of its mouth. In its Transformed state, the handle extends, turning the weapon into a highly unstable and destructive Maul. As part of this Bonus Action|XPHB, you can do the following:

- When you transform the Cannon into a Maul, you can shoot at your feet, even if the Cannon isn't loaded, using the deflagration to propel yourself and jump up to 30 feet in any direction. This jump doesn't cost you any movement.
- When you transform the Maul into a Cannon, you can reload the Cannon and retain its unstable force. If you reload it in this way, the next time you hit with a ranged attack with the Cannon on your turn, you are pushed back 30 feet in a straight line.

**Untransformed.** The Unstable Crumbler heats up Cannonball, transforming them into infernal ammunition. Whenever you roll a 15 or higher on the d20 when making a ranged attack roll with this weapon, the Cannonball becomes overheated and explodes on impact. When the Cannonball explodes in this way, it is considered an Explosive Cannonball.

**Transformed.** Whenever you roll an 18 or higher on the d20 when making an attack roll with this weapon, the Maul's head detonates, causing an effect that acts as the Fireball spell (save 15) centered on the target. If you succeed on this saving throw, you take no damage.
